decision_unit: one real engineering decision at one frozen project/source snapshot
primary_question: Same acceptably justified decision with less complete work than a competent conventional process
arms: competent analyst plus ordinary search and records
optional bounded parallel workflow only for predeclared independent subquestions
architecture_controls: same model revision for agent arms
same information access and source cutoff
same tool interface and eligible corpus
primary_gate: all decision-critical claims supported or explicitly qualified as inference/unknown
no fabricated source, number, or scope
citation_checks: relevance to decision established separately from citation existence
cost_fields: all model input/output and observed reasoning tokens
adversarial_controls: no admissible answer in frozen corpus
exposed eligible source omitted from output
analysis: pair by decision and source snapshot
quality requirement precedes cost advantage claim
declare minimum useful work reduction before evaluation
choose inferential sample size from required precision and effect, not convenient count
report each metric denominator and incomplete outcomes
no sub-agent message or citation treated as independent task
stop: no new evidence changes a named admissibility field on a closed lead
held-out result inconclusive: no expansion justified by point estimate alone
promotion: Only after frozen correctness and complete-work improvement criteria both pass on held-out decisions; this source review establishes neither
authority: Project-local contracts remain independent; no shared unattended coordinator or sibling runtime activated
